phrases.latin: quī Terminālibus nūper in suburbium, ut eōdem diē reverterer, īre nōn sum ausus
phrases.english: I who lately, at the Terminalia, did not dare go out to the outskirts, though I meant to come back the same day

phrases.latin: tumulus est in extrēmā parte urbis, āversus ā marī
phrases.english: there is a hill at the far edge of the city, facing away from the sea

phrases.latin: Avus in extrēmā urbe habitat, prope agrōs.
phrases.english: Grandpa lives on the edge of town, near the fields.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 206.
